title: CloudTrail Console Actions FilterPolicy
description: Schema for the declarative filter policy that replaces hardcoded FilterRecords logic. Sugar (bare strings, bracket paths) is desugared before validation.

preprocess.description: Working variables (preprocess.*) computed before filtering. eventName and userName are required: alerts are grouped by them.

outputs.description: Projection of an emitted record to the log/Slack schema. The listed fields are required: alerts are grouped, timed and linked by them.

keep.description: Global veto rules. An applicable keep rule forces EMIT, overriding any skip.

filters.description: Skip rules. A record is dropped if any applicable skip rule matches and no keep vetoes.

operator.description: Condition operators plus Matches/NotMatches (RE2). Numeric comparisons are kept for fields like length/count; duration operators are omitted (no time-based filtering need).

key.description: A {{ }} template expression resolved against the record and preprocess.*: a dotted path ("quoted" names for fields like x-amz-acl) with optional [n] indexing and '|| fallback', plus trimPrefix/contains/split/keys. NOT JMESPath; see docs/policy-language.md. Unresolvable paths evaluate to null (falsy), they do not error.

allOf.$comment: Set operators require an array value.
Equality/comparison operators require a single scalar value.

conditions.description: any: = OR, all: = AND. Both may appear and are ANDed together. Conditions do not nest (no all inside any); express AND-inside-OR by splitting into multiple rules.

action.description: All filter rules drop. Local exceptions go in exclude; global vetoes go in the top-level keep block.

keepRule.description: exclude is intentionally NOT permitted here, keeping the veto absolute and the policy terminating.

value.description: Template string, e.g. {{ userIdentity.userName }}, or an unquoted typed literal (true, 42).

outputField.description: Either an unconditional template string, or an ordered list of rules (first matching `when` wins).
